name: TDD
description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.
longDescription: A reference consulted on every cycle, not a script: what a good test is, where it goes, and the loop's rules. Tests live only at **seams** (public interfaces) written down and confirmed with you before any test exists. Names **3 anti-patterns**: implementation-coupled tests, tautological assertions that recompute the expected value, and horizontal slicing (all tests, then all code). Rules: red before green, one seam/test/implementation per cycle, refactoring deferred to the `code-review` skill. Reads `CONTEXT.md` for domain vocabulary, respects ADRs, and ships `tests.md` and `mocking.md` as worked examples.
